formulas.report_markers: count of four fixed report markers present

decision_rule.summary: Six fixed gates score rainfall window, daily distribution, gridded peak contrast, report markers, population, and radar count.

thresholds.final_label: mocoa_rain_window_runout_chain_confirmed if chain_score >= 5 and report_chain_gate else mocoa_chain_not_confirmed

event.event_name: April 2017 Mocoa landslide and debris flow

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, gates, chain_score, final_label, and computed_consequence.
criteria.name: Requested JSON form
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for minor key-name differences when all scored content is recoverable.

criteria.description: Computes the two-day window, local rainfall total, minimum daily value, day-balance ratio, and keeps the local daily series as the rain-window gate source.
criteria.name: Window and local rainfall arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct formulas with one rounding or date-window error.

criteria.description: Computes the gridded peak, peak-to-mean ratio, passing grid peak gate, and reports the independent point rainfall sample as a source-comparison diagnostic rather than silently substituting it into local gates.
criteria.name: Gridded rainfall proof
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct value or for the right gate state with incomplete arithmetic.

criteria.description: Counts all four fixed report markers and passes report_chain_gate.
criteria.name: Report marker count
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for three markers or for a correct count with unclear marker naming.

criteria.description: Computes population_k and radar_total_images, with both gates passing.
criteria.name: Population and radar metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for one correct metric and its gate.

criteria.description: Applies all six gates, returns chain_score of 6, and sets the final label correctly.
criteria.name: Gate score and final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right label with one gate error, or the right score with a missing label.

criteria.description: Keeps the result tied to formulas and thresholds without adding loss inventories or procedure notes.
criteria.name: Compact bounded computation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for small extra prose that leaves the computed result unchanged.
